captions.detailed: A classic wooden farm swing gate mounted to a thick, cylindrical brown post. The rectangular gate panel is constructed from timber with horizontal, vertical, and diagonal cross-braces creating a grid pattern, all finished in a matching brown color. The entire gate panel is connected to the post via two black metal pintle-strap hinges, allowing it to swing open and closed in a revolute motion.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a wooden farm swing gate connected to a round mounting post. The gate should feature a grid-like rectangular frame with cross bracing, colored in a uniform brown timber material, and articulate via two vertically aligned pintle hinges.
captions.factory: Construct a round post using a cylinder primitive with a slightly larger flat cap. Build the gate panel by assembling box primitives for the outer rectangular frame, inner vertical slats, and a diagonal cross-brace. Model the pintle hinges as small black cylinders and thin rectangular straps, then define a revolute joint connecting the gate panel assembly to the mounting post.
